thread:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected on inference streaming (/v1/stream) starting 2005012300 — automated SLO alert. Error class: auth gateway 5xx + DB timeouts. Paging on-call.
ben_oncall: On it. Paging DB/Security. Reports of streaming stalls and high tail latency (p95->800ms, p99->3.6s).
alice_sre: Observed a sharp increase in auth 502s from control-plane auth-proxy cluster, ~30% of requests. KV cache fill rate also spiked.
dmitri_eng: seeing rate limit throttle logs from auth: `rate_limit_exceeded user_token=*, window=60s` and auth upstream 503s. Dumping last 200 auth responses now.
fiona_db: DB pools show many connections waiting, `max_connections` near capacity on config-store primary. Slow queries on feature_flag lookup table (hot partition).
carla_prod: Customer impact: several enterprise customers reported streaming stalls and repeated reconnects. No data loss but interactive sessions degrade. Notifying affected AEs.
elaine_support: Tickets inbound — two P1s from customers in EU. Channeling them to SRE for mitigation notes.
ben_oncall: Quick mitigation plan: 1) enable config-cache fallback in runtime (serve cached flags), 2) temporarily bump auth gateway rate limit window for trusted clients, 3) route streaming to secondary auth cluster, 4) throttle non-interactive background requests.
alice_sre: Agreed. I'm applying cache-fallback toggle now. Runtime flag: `use_cached_feature_flags=true` (will avoid DB lookups).
dmitri_eng: Pushing auth policy change to increase burst limit for Redwood core clients: `auth.policy.rate_limit.burst=200`. Applying now to canary. deploy-bot: canary rollout started for auth-proxy (svc/auth-proxy -> 10% traffic).
deploy-bot: Canary logs: auth-proxy-canary healthy, no 5xx observed in canary window.
fiona_db: Started a read-only failover for config-store and increased `max_connections` by 25% on the replica. Watching queue length.
alice_sre: Running a rolling restart of gateway pods to pick up cache toggle. Command:
```
kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deploy/gateway --selector=role=streaming-gateway
```
ben_oncall: Also enabling client-side backoff in streaming proxy for 401/502 to reduce retry storm.
dmitri_eng: Observed immediate p95 improvement after enabling cached flags: p95 -> 240ms, p99 -> 980ms (pre-mitigation p99 3.6s). Still watching tail.
carla_prod: Communicating to top impacted customers: we have a mitigation in place, working on full recovery.
elaine_support: Updating tickets and sending temporary mitigation instructions to customers: increase client backoff, avoid polling.
alice_sre: Post-mitigation steps: 1) create follow-up to optimize feature_flag queries (indexing, sharding), 2) capacity plan for auth gateway, 3) add circuit-breaker to inference path for config-store. Assigning owners.
ben_oncall: Handoff to on-call rotation in 30m. If p99 < 1s for 15m and no 5xx, will close paging.
incident_bot: Incident annotated: tags=[latency, streaming, auth, config-cache, oncall-handoff]. Severity: SEV2.
dmitri_eng: :eyes: I'll open a postmortem draft and attach query plans and the recent deploys log.
carla_prod: :thumbsup: Keep me posted, I need a customer-facing summary for tomorrow.
